verifications.claim: Kyler Murray has signed a one-year contract with the Minnesota Vikings for the 2026 season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Pelissero: Kyler Murray signs 1-year contract with Vikings" (R1); "quarterback Kyler Murray signed a one-year deal with the Minnesota Vikings" for 2026 (R2); "has signed a one-year deal for the league minimum with the Minnesota Vikings" (R4); "He will sign a one-year deal worth $1.3 million" (R6); "The Vikings on Thursday announced they have signed veteran quarterback Kyler Murray" (R8); "agreed to a one-year contract with Minnesota" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state the signing of a one-year contract with the Vikings explicitly tied to the 2026 season.

verifications.claim: The contract is worth the veteran minimum of $1.3 million.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "veteran minimum of $1.3 million for the 2026 season" (R2); "veteran minimum ($1.3 million)" (R3); "one-year deal for the league minimum" of $1.3M (R4); "one-year deal worth $1.3 million – the veteran minimum" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the contract value as the veteran minimum of exactly $1.3 million.

verifications.claim: Kyler Murray was released by the Arizona Cardinals.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "released by the Arizona Cardinals" (R2); "Kyler Murray and the Arizona Cardinals officially went their separate ways with a post June-1 designated release" (R3); "officially released by the Arizona Cardinals on Wednesday" (R4); "Arizona decided last week to release him" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Murray was released by the Cardinals.

verifications.claim: Kyler Murray is guaranteed $36.8 million in 2026 from his previous contract with Arizona.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "$36.8 million salary" guaranteed from Arizona (R2); "guaranteed $36.8 million this season by the Cardinals" (R4); "Arizona still owes Murray $36.8 million in guarantees for the 2026 season" (R6); "The Cardinals still owe Murray $36.8 million" (R9)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the exact $36.8 million guarantee for 2026 from the Arizona contract.

verifications.claim: The deal includes a no-tag clause.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Murray's deal with Minnesota includes a no-tag clause, Rapoport and Pelissero added."
verifications.reasoning: Source directly states the Vikings deal includes a no-tag clause.

verifications.claim: The Cardinals released Murray, triggering the massive guaranteed salary.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Arizona will pay the rest due to the nature of releasing him" (R2); post-June 1 release affects cap/dead money but guarantee pre-exists (R3); "guaranteed $36.8 million this season by the Cardinals" prior to release mention (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the guarantee exists independently; release does not 'trigger' it but results in Arizona paying it despite Murray signing elsewhere—no source supports 'triggering' by release.

verifications.claim: The Cardinals' release of Murray allowed him to sign elsewhere for the minimum.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "knew they could acquire Murray and pay him the veteran minimum" due to Arizona paying (R2); "have a chance to sign the quarterback on a one-year prove-it deal worth the veteran minimum" post-release (R3); "able to sign Murray to a minimum deal ... because Murray is guaranteed $36.8 million ... by the Cardinals" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly link the release and guarantee to enabling a minimum deal elsewhere.

verifications.claim: In 2022, Kyler Murray signed a five-year, $230.5 million extension with the Cardinals.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "extension he signed in 2022" (R4); "five-year contract extension... worth $230.5 million" in 2022 (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm the exact 2022 five-year, $230.5M extension with Cardinals.

verifications.claim: The 2022 extension included $160 million in guaranteed money.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: Source directly states the exact $160M guaranteed in the 2022 extension.

verifications.claim: The 2022 extension included a "homework clause" that was later removed
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "independent study" clause (homework clause) in 2022 extension (R7); "famous "independent study" clause that was inserted into the quarterback's extension in 2022" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm inclusion of 'independent study'/'homework' clause in 2022 extension, but describe in general terms without explicitly confirming 'later removed'—supported but less precise on removal.
